CveFindings.Name: Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions in Newtonsoft.Json
CveFindings.Description:
[CVE-2024-21907](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5crp-9r3c-p9vr): Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions in Newtonsoft.Json

Severity: HIGH

Affected dependencies:
  - Newtonsoft.Json 10.0.3 (NYCJobsWeb/packages.config:17)
  - Newtonsoft.Json 9.0.1 (DataLoader/DataLoader/packages.config:3)

Both versions are below the affected-range fix of 13.0.1. Recommended fix: upgrade to Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.1 or later.

CweFindings.Name: Unchecked Input for Loop Condition
CweFindings.Description: The product does not properly check inputs that are used for loop conditions, potentially leading to a denial of service or other consequences because of excessive looping.
CweFindings.Explanation:
CleanText(text) loops while text.indexOf(/ /g) > -1. String.indexOf coerces the regex to the literal string "/ /g"; if external indexed job text contains that sequence, the condition remains true while text.replace(/ /g, "
") does not alter it, causing an unbounded loop and browser denial of service.

CweFindings.Name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
CweFindings.Description: The product contains an iteration or loop with an exit condition that cannot be reached, i.e., an infinite loop.
CweFindings.Explanation:
CleanText(text) loops while text.indexOf(/ /g) > -1. String.indexOf coerces the regex to the literal string "/ /g"; if external indexed job text contains that sequence, the condition remains true while text.replace(/ /g, "
") does not alter it, causing an unbounded loop and browser denial of service.

CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: The search page concatenates Azure Search document fields (business_title, work_location, id, and job_description/highlights) into an HTML string and inserts it with jQuery .html() in UpdateJobDetails (lines 397-416). The detail page also inserts returned document fields through .html() (lines 49-80); CleanText only performs text substitutions and does not HTML-encode the values. Search-index content can therefore be interpreted as markup/script by other users.
